A fellow forester showed me this path. He said that people were afraid to pick mushrooms near the plant, so it was always full of good pickings.
tasks.okMsg: You didn't lose anything along the way, correct? All right, then it's time to send the engineers out to do some measurements, we're about to find out what these factory walls are hiding. Thanks for your help, friend.

tasks.name: Special Comms

obj.text: Stash a Military cable at the boulder next to RUAF gate on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Reserve
Stash a Bulbex cable cutter at the sandbags next to LAV III above the storage warehouse on Reserve

tasks.desc:
Salutations! An important assignment has just come from the high-ups. Top priority and all that jazz. There's a path from Priozersk to the Reserve base, and our guys need communication in those parts urgently.

The path? Ah well, I'll share it with you, but make sure nobody else knows about it! When the Contract Wars were in full swing, some artisan managed to lay a path parallel to our road. We tracked the guy down and started interrogating him on who he was working for, what kind of mission he was on, you know the drill. 

We thought we'd captured a spy! Yet he kept calling himself a mushroom picker and grinning like a moron. We wanted to send him to headquarters. But at night our mushroom picker disappeared, no one saw him again after that.

So, with your help, we'll build a communication line along this path, and you'll be responsible for the equipment. You'll deliver a part of it to the place, go to the Reserve base, and leave the second part there.
tasks.okMsg:
Your country will be proud of you, soldier! 

But the fact that the Scavs started roaming around this path worries me a bit... Someone must be scouting for all the forgotten shortcut routes on Tarkov's map.

tasks.name: Forester's Duty

obj.text: Eliminate Scavs on Lighthouse (In one raid)
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Shoreline (In one raid)
Eliminate Scavs on Shoreline (In one raid)

tasks.desc:
Hello. I used to walk many a footpath myself, but time has bested me. The looters have cleaned out all the popular places, and now they're heading into the forests. 

I saw some of those Scavs the other day. They were dragging something through the swamp near Azure Coast. Even before the war, people used to call this place a death trap. Only I and my mushroom picker friend knew how to cross it in one piece and survive.

Would you scare those bandits away? Make them know the forests are not for them to ravage. Make sure you cross that path I mentioned too, clean it for good.
tasks.okMsg:
The forest likes quiet, we can't let them destroy such places. 

I don't know how they could have found out about this trail... My friend has never shown his paths to bad people.

tasks.name: Rough Tarkov

obj.text: Locate the heavily mined area at the USEC camp on Woods
Locate the Claymore mine on Ground Zero

tasks.desc:
Hello there. I see you've become very confident in your survival skills. That's what gets people killed. Overconfidence weakens your senses, and Tarkov doesn't tolerate it. 

I was talking to an old comrade of mine, and let me tell you, tripwires are the ultimate test of alertness. Partisan has driven a great many bastards out of existence, and most of the time it was only a matter of catching the enemy inattentive. Yes, his methods are extreme, he's been like that since Afghanistan.

Even if you're on my friend's good side, there are still plenty of "gifts" in Tarkov even without him. Not just in the woods, too. Sometimes even a random room can come with an explosive surprise. That's why I advise you to cut down on your eagerness and take a closer look at such places. 

You'll live longer if you learn to recognize mortal danger.
tasks.okMsg: Would you look at that, you're alive! While you were gone, I've prepped this little thingie for you, so you can learn the secrets of booby trapping on your own. Consider it a homework assignment, but just make sure to not blow yourself up.

tasks.name: Shipping Delay - Part 2

obj.text: Locate and scout the office at the depot on Woods
Locate and scout the warehouses at the depot on Woods
Locate and scout the garages at the depot on Woods
Complete the task A Helping Hand

tasks.desc:
So Mechanic sent you, huh? Cool. So I used to have a base, with a hangar, spare parts, cargo shipments even. Then some assholes thought they could just clean the place out! I'm gonna find those bastards. But while I'm at it, all the deliveries are messing up! 

The most important one is a package for Prapor, he's really anxious for it, and the box is still at the depot near the sawmill in Priozersk. If you're down to help me, look for this package and deliver it to Prapor. I can give you a ride to the depot, but I ain't leaving the BTR. I don't like it outside, it's more comforting inside this armor.
tasks.okMsg:
So, was Prapor pissed? Well shit, it's an emergency over here! But hey, thanks for helping me out.

Now I might go and check out what's left of the base. You're a good guy, so stay in touch, yeah? When I find these shitheads, I'll need your help again.

tasks.name: Shipping Delay - Part 1

obj.text: Hand over the package from the depot on Woods

tasks.desc:
Hey, do you know the BTR driver who's driving around Tarkov? I ordered an important delivery from him, but he just vanished somewhere.

If I had a soldier like that at my disposal, I'd teach him a lesson real quick. How can you delay military cargo shipments?! He was supposed to meet with my men yesterday.

I need to find that bastard and show him what responsibility means. But the package is more important at the moment. Go find it and hand it over to me. We'll deal with the driver later.
tasks.okMsg:
You talked with the driver, huh? His base was attacked? If you ask me, those couriers will always make excuses for being late.

But the guy did a good job hiring you. I've been dying to get this little package.

tasks.name: Hot Wheels

obj.text: Locate and mark the spare BTR wheels with an MS2000 Marker
Complete the main objective as soon as possible

tasks.desc:
So I went to the depot... Those assholes ruined the place and took my spare parts. I mean, I can understand tools or equipment. But why the fuck would someone take the fucking wheels? You're not gonna build a second BTR like that.

Anyway, I need a spare wheel, and the sooner the better. You gotta find where the proper wheels could be laying around. I don't know where to look exactly, but you're not a moron, you'll figure it out. You can start with the customs area, but I haven't been there for ages, so I can't promise they'll be there.
tasks.okMsg: Awesome! These will do, and you also did it quick. I commend that! Changing the wheels will take some time though, it's not a Lada after all.
tasks.failMsg:
This is a joke, right?

These are fucking truck wheels, you idiot. I'm driving a BTR. B-T-R! Go mark fucking bicycle wheels next while you're at it.

tasks.name: Hot Wheels - Let's Try Again

obj.text: Locate and mark the spare BTR wheels with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve

tasks.desc:
We've already lost time, but if we wait any longer, the BTR's gonna stall. While you were screwing around, I did some digging and found out where we can get some proper wheels. Go to the reserve military base, the wheels we need are there. 

They come with rims attached, and they're a proper diameter for the BTR, too. Don't mess it up this time, the deadline's coming up.
tasks.okMsg:
There you go. It's a pain in the ass to change the wheels, but at least we have spares now. 

Thanks for your help. And, uh, I'm sorry for being an asshole. I just really can't lose my baby while we're dealing with this emergency.

tasks.name: Inevitable Response

obj.text: Eliminate Scavs on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Reserve
Eliminate Scavs on Reserve

tasks.desc:
Have you seen the new wheels? Actually, nevermind, before you fuck them up by looking at them or something. We've lost enough time, but there's a chance we can still find those half-assed engineers. I learned they came from the reserve base. If we don't hesitate, we can still catch up with them and punish them. 

Start in the forest and follow that path to the military base, we need to nail these assholes before they lay low.
tasks.okMsg: You got them in time? Good. Let the others think twice before ransacking my place again.

tasks.name: Order From Outside

obj.text: Locate and obtain the electronic jammer at the electromechanical warehouse on Reserve
Stash the device at the specified location on Woods

tasks.desc:
Surely you don't think I would be interested in petty local conflicts? I have much more important matters to attend to, and I am not going to help either of the parties. Speaking of which. I need to move an item from point A to point B. 

It is hidden at the electromechanical warehouse in the airspace control center at the military base. It's to be delivered to the Priozersk nature reserve. The landmark will be a small cemetery. You'll recognize it by the stretchers and the bodies around it -- not everyone has been buried in time. 

Since my cargo is very specific, some people may have a particular interest in it. That is why I need someone who can guarantee the safety of the cargo during transportation.
tasks.okMsg: Perfect. I've already prepared the reward.
tasks.failMsg: I thought you were dead, so I have already given the job to another person. Next time, don't take too long to complete the tasks I give you.

tasks.name: Building Foundations

obj.text: Sell any items to Prapor
Sell any items to Peacekeeper
Sell any items to Ragman

tasks.desc:
You know, you've been helping me out for a while now, and I haven't even brought you up to speed with this whole situation. So, I'm working with Skier now. I deliver his goods, and sometimes I'm involved in his operations. At first it was a nice lucrative gig, but now this asshole won't let me off the hook for even a second. He thinks I'm his personal fucking mule now!

He seems to have found out somehow that I'm tired of all this, and now he's brought his punks to my base to teach me a lesson. I'm not gonna put up with this shit anymore. I'd leave him a long time ago, but I do need protection and guarantees, you know. And since you're in contact with other traders, you could put in a good word for me. Can you help a friend out?
tasks.okMsg:
Yeah, well, I was kinda expecting that.

But the key is that we've made a start. Now I have a real chance of getting away from this shithead.

tasks.name: Natural Exchange

obj.text: Stash the first metal fuel tank at the smugglers' base on Shoreline
Stash the second metal fuel tank at the smugglers' base on Shoreline

tasks.desc:
Your friends are still taking their time, and I'm already running low on supplies because of that depot attack. I'm gonna run out of fuel if I don't do something. I found a place to get fuel, but I need your help.

You know the local smugglers? They got a base near the Azure Coast. That's where you gotta drop off some gas cans. They'll fill me some fuel in return. But I think we can handle that part without you. They'll send their own people. So, you in?
tasks.okMsg: Perfect. At least now the baby won't die in the middle of a random field. Thank you, friend!

tasks.name: Forge a Friendship

obj.text: Locate and obtain Prapor's cargo on Shoreline
Hand over the found cargo

tasks.desc:
Hello, warrior! You asked about the BTR driver, and in theory we could work together. I've already used the services of his BTR, but going against Skier is not cheap.

That's why we need to solidify our intentions, so that no one slips up later! First, I need to get a package that came from outside the cordon. I'm told it's already here, somewhere in the Norvinsk port area.
tasks.okMsg: Good work, soldier! I'll be in touch with you about working with the driver.

tasks.name: Half-Empty

obj.text: Hand over the found in raid military electronic items
Hand over the found in raid PC component items

tasks.desc:
So, about that cargo from across the cordon. Turns out it was only part of the shipment. The other part's supposed to be airdropped. But I suspect they didn't include everything there either, those bastards.

Look, you could help me with this. The package still needs to be picked up. And if we don't actually have everything, we'll have to look somewhere else. Obviously, I'm not gonna work with these suppliers anymore, but right now I need all these electronics from the shipment.

I won't forget your commitment. Who knows, maybe I'll figure out how to help comrade driver quicker after you're done.
tasks.okMsg: You really helped me out! If the BTR driver is as reliable as you, we'll certainly get along. I just need to finish some other urgent things and prepare everything.

tasks.name: Stick in the Wheel

obj.text: Eliminate any target on any location

tasks.desc:
Here about the BTR driver again? Listen, it's not that simple. But things are slowly progressing, thanks to you. By the way, the Scavs are really coming down on my soldiers right now. 

I don't know if it's Skier who has learned something about our plans, or if someone is actively recruiting new bandits, but it's impossible to do business like this, that's for sure. If you want your comrade and I to work together, you have to remove this hindrance.
tasks.okMsg:
No more sticks in the wheels now. Thank you.

You can tell your friend that I will soon prepare everything for him to come under our protection.

tasks.name: Another Shipping Delay

obj.text: Locate the missing courier crew on Woods
Survive and extract from the location

tasks.desc:
Hey, brother! You say the BTR driver wants to leave Skier's gang? You know, that kind of transport would be good for my trade. But you do realize Skier won't appreciate such a move, and it's a risk to my business. Anyway, it's a lot to think about and weigh.

Though, you can make the driver's offer more convincing. I got some urgent business to take care of. I lost contact with one of my crews. The guys were running a delivery and they were supposed to be back by now. Return to me if you find any sign of them.
tasks.okMsg:
Someone's iced the couriers, huh? This means I have to switch routes, I've got three more trips planned! 

Man, I can't stop the trade, I need new routes. Maybe your driver friend could give some tips? Go ask him where I can move the goods safely. Pretty please.

tasks.name: Ask for Directions

obj.text: Locate and mark the first section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the second section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the third section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the fourth section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

tasks.desc:
So Ragman's looking for new routes, you say? I'm thinking about that myself right now, since Skier won't let me go so easily. But there is one option that Ragman could use. I won't pass on my BTR through there, but when I was a puny pedestrian, I used to sneak around there often.

You know the village by the cliffs where the cottages are? You can go up from one of the backyards, and then follow the crevice. Then, you reach those wealthy houses, you'll have to be on guard over there.

There are no truly safe roads left, so I guess this one's better than nothing. Just make sure you come back to me when you've marked it, I'll double check it with my maps just to be sure.
tasks.okMsg:
I think you got it all right. Honestly, I don't remember the details very well...

But there was no other such path in the cliffs, so yeah, it's all good.

tasks.name: Stabilize Business

obj.text: Eliminate Scavs in one raid on Ground Zero
Survive and extract from the location

tasks.desc:
I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards.

I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish.
tasks.okMsg:
That's great! Now there is nothing to interfere with my operations, and we can think about expansion.

For now, I need to figure out how to prepare for the BTR coming under my roof. Just be patient for a little longer.

tasks.name: Battery Change

obj.text: Find the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery
Hand over the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery

tasks.desc:
How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Prapor needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously.

I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR.

You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me.
tasks.okMsg: That's a big one! I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle. Alright, just leave it right here. You're doing a lot of work for me, and I won't forget it. Thank you.

tasks.name: Battery Change

obj.text: Find the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery
Hand over the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery

tasks.desc:
How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Ragman needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously.

I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR.

You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me.
tasks.okMsg: That's a big one! I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle. Alright, just leave it right here. You're doing a lot of work for me, and I won't forget it. Thank you.

tasks.name: Protect the Sky

obj.text: Locate the package in the specified spot on Woods
Hand over the package

tasks.desc:
You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense.

Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it.

Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase.
tasks.okMsg:
Thank you! At least now I have a place to sleep.

Nothing will come down from above now. And on the ground, the landmines should stop them. I've covered everything. Let's see them looting my spare parts again!

tasks.name: Discombobulate

obj.text: Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the first RPG ammo crate on Woods
Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the second RPG ammo crate on Woods
Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the third RPG ammo crate on Woods

tasks.desc:
I was right about Skier. He's not just trying to interrupt my work, he's trying to fucking destroy the BTR! Looks like somebody supplied him with a big load of RPG rockets. 

Those knuckle-dragging idiots can't even shoot it properly, but so what? With enough ammo, they'll take me down if not on the first, then on the tenth attempt. However, I might have an idea where Skier is storing these rockets. Plenty of time's passed, they've already organized their firing positions, I'm sure of it.

They could be anywhere in the city, but in the forest we may be able to find all of their positions. Just follow my usual driving route and check all the places they might use to ambush me.

Find the rocket crates and leave some presents for those fuckers. Let them have an explosive surprise when they come for their ammo.
tasks.okMsg: Magnificent! I think I heard one explosion about 20 minutes ago already. Now this bitch Skier will think twice before threatening me.

tasks.name: The Price of Independence

obj.text: Locate and obtain the incriminating letter on Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Stash the letter on the third floor of the military headquarters on Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Eliminate any target on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station warehouse on Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the pier on Lighthouse
Eliminate Scavs while completing the other objectives
Survive and extract from Lighthouse

tasks.desc:
We foiled Skier's plans, and I'll tell you this - we can't let this opportunity slip away. When he recovers, he will never let me out of his sight. That's why we need to think of a defensive plan now, because you and I are both going to get nailed! So listen, I've got a plan all worked out. Except I don't have anybody else I'd trust to do something this complex. 

I was able to dig up some background intel on Skier. The kind of information that could compromise him real bad if it fell into the right hands. It's all in this letter, and it's our guarantee. You need to pick it up at the customs area. The letter will be on the top floor of the building by the construction site. You know, the one near the railroad platform, you'll see it. Hopefully.

From there, go straight to the reserve base and leave it in the headquarters on the third floor, at the fortified point with windows. The key is to make sure that Skier's men don't intercept the letter. That is why after stashing the letter, run to Priozersk and make some noise. 

After you kill a couple of Scavs, go to the lighthouse peninsula and shoot a flare. You need a yellow one, don't get it mixed up! The best place to do it is on the pier at the vacation houses and on the platform at the train station, it'll distract the guys from Skier's nearest base. After that, you run out of there! 

I've written all the instructions on a piece of paper to make sure you don't fuck it up. You gotta do it all at once, you understand?
tasks.okMsg:
Ho-ly shit! You did it! You're the only one to stick up for me. What's most important is that we've already prepared the stage.

It won't be easy, but Prapor promised to help, and the letter ought to work too. I won't forget all the help you've given me. Drop by often, friend.
tasks.failMsg:
It didn't work out, friend. Skier has intercepted the damn letter. We sure were close, weren't we? Nobody even knew about this!

I guess I don't have any options to break away from Skier yet.

tasks.name: The Price of Independence

Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Stash the letter on the third floor of the military headquarters on Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Eliminate any target on Woods

Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station warehouse on Lighthouse

tasks.name: The Higher They Fly

obj.text: Eliminate PMC operatives on Woods

tasks.desc:
Hello-hello. I've got a worker guy who's gotten a little carried away with his ambitions. Obviously, I'll handle it later. The problem right now is that some PMCs are getting involved. I don't know if they've been bribed, or maybe they're in cahoots with this mule of mine.

Thing is, I don't need any extra faces in this matter, so these good little helpers need to be taken out of the picture. Last time they "operated" in the Priozersk area, so you're gonna start there.
tasks.okMsg: Nice one! If any of those idiots are still thinking about helping this poor lad, now they're aware of all the risks that come with it.
tasks.failMsg:
Thought you could have a foot in both camps, you dumb fuck?

A real pro knows how to pick a side. You fucked up, and believe me, you're not gonna unfuck it now.

tasks.name: Swift Retribution

obj.text: Eliminate Scavs on Woods

tasks.desc:
So? Feel how smooth it runs now? You did me a solid with the wheels. 

Now we can start thinking about the fuckers who robbed my base. They can't have gotten far, they're probably still in the nature reserve. Go and punish those fucks, will you?
tasks.okMsg: Nice work! Now the Scavs will think twice before messing with me.

tasks.name: Simple Side Job

obj.text: Locate and obtain Lightkeeper's cargo crate on the roof of the military hospital on Reserve
Stash the cargo at the Scav house on Woods

tasks.desc:
I am not interested in localized conflicts and I am not going to help either side. But since you are already here, I have a job for you.

The task is simple: pick up one cargo from the roof of the military hospital at the reserve base and deliver it to the transfer point. Be careful with the cargo and do not open the crate. This shipment might be of interest to certain people, so I need a man with special skills. Someone like you.
tasks.okMsg: Well done. The reward will not disappoint you.
tasks.failMsg: You shouldn't have taken so long to complete my task. I've already found another merc who works faster.

tasks.name: Route Deviation

obj.text: Mark the Collapsed Crane BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Old Scav Checkpoint BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Pinewood Hotel BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the City Center BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Tram BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Rodina Cinema BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov

tasks.desc:
Yeah-yeah, your previous job was about the BTR driver. So what? It makes no difference to you. We made a deal, but the kid's still looking for ways around it. If I didn't know how to manage lads like him, I wouldn't have gotten on top myself.

You need good intel to manage them so you can nail them in time. There are no issues in Priozersk, but in the city he often deviates from my routes. I need to know where the BTR goes and why. Mark all his stops with strobe markers, after that my lads will handle it.
tasks.okMsg: You got all the spots, yeah? Cool. I'm gonna send my crew to check it out today, this rat's not going anywhere.
tasks.failMsg:
You decided to help the driver? Predictions don't seem to be your strong suit.

Without me, his wheelbarrow will fall apart, and without it, he'll be clapped by the first guy he meets! That's when you'll come crawling back to me.

tasks.name: Hindsight 20/20

obj.text: Stash the first Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker
Stash the second Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker
Locate the bunker under the mountain on Woods
Stash the third Russian armor-piercing ammo pack inside the bunker

tasks.desc:
New assignment for ya. The driver still has someone helping him, and he knows too much to be left alone. If this shithead leaks my stashes, I'm gonna have to reorganize the whole fucking network!

The lads are already looking for new spots for merchandise drop-offs and ammo storage. You need to check one of these points, it's supposedly somewhere under the large mountain in Priozersk. If the tip is accurate, you can leave the supplies there for my crew. We need Russian armor-piercing ammo specifically. Keep your NATO ammo and other junk to yourself.
tasks.okMsg: The bunker is open? These hooded pricks could be a problem, but they're not the focus at the moment. The plan can't be changed, but I will notify the group anyway.
tasks.failMsg:
If you wanted to work for both sides, you should've been more fucking careful! 

You won't make it far with that sucker. But you've already made your choice, fuckhead.

tasks.name: Key Partner

obj.text: Sell any items to Peacekeeper

tasks.desc:
So a birdie told me the driver is determined and is looking for a new employer. I doubt the idiot realizes all the consequences of such a transition. In any case, I never even gave him that option anyway! The only lead I've confirmed now is about Peacekeeper. 

You should go to him and remind him that we have common interests with him! Make him remember who his key partner is.
tasks.okMsg: Peacekeeper is a forward thinker, even if he wants to seem like a simple hustler. He won't dare to go against me now.
tasks.failMsg:
Did you think I wouldn't find out about you helping the driver? You think I can't replace you?

You're gonna have to work very hard if you want to do business with me again.

tasks.name: Killer Argument

obj.text: Locate and obtain the package with RPG ammo on Woods
Hand over the package

tasks.desc:
Have you already heard that the driver has poached some of the traders over to his side? This kid's gotten a little far from his nest, so it's time to end it. I've made a deal with a certain someone to share some RPG ammo, enough to penetrate his BTR's armor. 

Now I need someone to deliver the package from the Scav house in Priozersk. Nobody knows about the delivery yet, so it should go smoothly. You gotta work fast, so that the driver doesn't find out what I'm preparing for him.
tasks.okMsg: Very good! Now the BTR armor won't save the driver. Stay in touch, you'll be useful during the assault.
tasks.failMsg:
You're too sharp for your own good, punk. A proper bandit would never do that shit.

You can't betray your own gang. Who'd want to do business with you now?

tasks.name: Choose Your Friends Wisely

obj.text: Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Eliminate PMC operatives while completing the other objectives

tasks.desc:
The assault is called off. Someone tipped off the driver about the ammo crates, so this motherfucker booby-trapped them! My lads got nailed. Now we're out of both manpower and ammo. We'll have to look for shells again. The driver's gonna start his bullshit counterattack now, you need to stop him.

If we let him build his route system now, he's gonna be a pain in the ass later. He's got some mercs around him again, but now they all know they're going against Skier! You need to do this quickly so that no one thinks they can oppose me and fucking survive. I got a route where you'll find all these shitheads.
tasks.okMsg:
Well, no one can help him after something like this. I'll take care of the little stuff, but without you, it could have gone south.

You're a smooth guy, and you kept your word, unlike that driver fuck.
tasks.failMsg:
So it was you who was helping him the whole time? No wonder you're backing off now.

You know I can deal with him one way or the other, right? But you, you're gonna be cleaning up this shit for a very long while.

tasks.name: A Helping Hand

obj.text: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods
Survive and extract from the location
Complete the task Shipping Delay - Part 1

tasks.desc:
Hello. I figure you've already seen the BTR that's been driving around Tarkov. The driver used to offer his services to PMCs like you, but lately he has started working with Skier as well. The driver came to me when he was restoring the BTR. It was an quite an interesting challenge, let me tell you. But that's beside the point. 

He hasn't been in touch for quite some time, and now he's suddenly asked for help. Apparently, something serious has happened. Can you check in with him and find out what's going on? There aren't many men of wit and ambition left in Tarkov. People like us should stick together.
tasks.okMsg:
I told him it was dangerous to become part of Skier's gang... Granted, it does have its privileges, but you can hardly stay independent in such a big business. 

I wonder who could have turned against Skier? After all, the BTR should be under his protection...

tasks.name: Abandoned Cargo

obj.text: Mark any of the special TerraGroup cargo boxes with an MS2000 Marker on Customs
Locate the first special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the second special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the third special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the fourth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the fifth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the sixth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
Locate the seventh special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

tasks.desc:
Good afternoon, young man. I have received information about a recent suspicious shipment of TerraGroup cargo. According to the description, it could contain valuable records and even medical samples.

Every such shipment should have been prioritized for extraction, yet for some reason this shipment was left near the customs terminal. I have to know what's inside the cargo, and to do that, I need the exact location of the shipments.

Will you be able to assist with this? You will recognize the necessary shipments by the boxes with the TerraGroup logo.
tasks.okMsg:
Excellent! You didn't open the boxes, correct? Good judgment, mercenary. It's best to have the professionals do it. 

Judging by the location of the shipments, they were abandoned in a hurry, or perhaps something happened during the transportation... We will have to investigate why TerraGroup decided to leave these shipments in Tarkov.

tasks.name: Shipment Tracking

obj.text: Locate and obtain the TerraGroup shipment lists on Customs
Hand over the found information

tasks.desc:
My people haven't been able to access the cargo yet. However, if there's anything of value-- I mean of danger, we can't waste any time.

All shipments had to be documented one way or another. Perhaps an itinerary or a cargo manifest would shed more light on the situation. You need to locate that piece of information.

Look in the offices of key persons at the customs: directors, supervisors. If there is anything we might find, it should be there.
tasks.okMsg:
It will take some time for me to study these documents. Nevertheless, we will soon discover everything that is wrong with this shipment and what it contains. 

Along with a report from my specialists, we will receive comprehensive details.

tasks.name: Closer to the People

obj.text: Locate and obtain the delivery crew's shipment notes on Customs
Hand over the found information

tasks.desc:
Terrible news, young man. I have stopped receiving communications from my group, and the documents you brought me have been scrubbed of all the essential information.

We know neither the project code, nor the detailed itinerary. Not even a summary of these boxes' contents! I cannot possibly ask you to open them yourself. What if my group's demise has something to do with their contents?

Instead, I came up with another idea. The documents said that in the event of obstacles along the transit, the delivery crews could opt to deviate from the route.

If the movers were attacked during transit, we might learn about it from the workers' records. Examine the places where the delivery crews may have stayed and search for this information.
tasks.okMsg:
Impossible... According to these records, no one attacked the movers, the path was clear! 

Yet the workers who spent several hours near the boxes reported itching and fever, and asked to go home.

The foreman's notes say that two delivery crews abandoned the boxes during transportation and flatly refused to continue their work! 

It turns out that the transportation of these boxes required special protective equipment, which no one considered to provide to ordinary workers. It's unclear how dangerous the boxes are at the moment, but I wouldn't recommend approaching them without the appropriate equipment.

tasks.name: Passion for Ergonomics

obj.text: Locate and obtain the customized tool set at the garage complex on Customs
Hand over the found item

tasks.desc:
Hello. Do you know the feeling when you change the layout of your instrument in a seemingly insignificant way and it fundamentally changes the working comfort?

The Pareto principle, right. I had a friend who was the epitome of that concept. He was always tweaking something, filing, sanding a part to win a few millimeters....

His experience made me realize how important ergonomics is in any job. I have not heard from him in a while, but I know one of his outlets, it was either a sort of car service or a workshop, right in the garage complex. He always loved cars, especially the American ones.

Can you come and check the place out? He probably moved somewhere else a long time ago, but his garage might still contain some of his tools or blueprints.
tasks.okMsg:
Hmm... He would never let his car burn down willingly. Something must have happened there.

A car mechanic's death would be just an imperceptible blip in the death toll on the Tarkov scale. But hopefully he was able to make it out and find safety. Maybe we'll see each other again.

tasks.name: Work Smarter

obj.text: Locate the secret exfil on Customs
Obtain the special item to extract through the secret exfil

tasks.desc:
You know how heated it can be at the safe exits around here. Many die on the road back, not on the actual trip.

That's why for a true hunter, it's important to always have something prepared, like a personal escape plan. Times are tough right now, so I don't advise taking unnecessary risks.

Take customs for example. I heard that some of the exits are now under someone's control, and they're only letting in their own kind. Which means no more outsiders will be allowed in. You might want to find a way to secure those exits for yourself. 

It may take some finesse, but for a true warrior, such obstacles shouldn't be a problem.
tasks.okMsg:
You've learned your lesson. Make sure you don't forget it. 

Always be prepared for your return path to be cut short. No matter which part of Tarkov you find yourself in. Your knowledge of the terrain, the paths between the areas and safe escape routes is your strength.

tasks.name: Seizing the Initiative

obj.text: Use the transit from Customs to Shoreline
Survive and extract from Shoreline

tasks.desc:
The operational situation in the city is ever-changing, meaning I always have to stay on top of what is happening.

My people have reported that some operatives have started using the new path from the customs terminal to the gulf coast.

Previously the passage was inaccessible there, but I've already had two targets evade my groups in that area. I have to see what is going on at that passage.

If you accept this task, you will have to travel all the way from the customs terminal to the coast and extract from there. You can count on an appropriate reward!
tasks.okMsg:
This will help us cut off the escape routes of those who prevent us from conducting our business.

Everyone needs resources to operate in Tarkov, and the Blue Helmets are no exception.

tasks.name: Rite of Passage

obj.text: Eliminate Scavs at the old gas station on Customs
Eliminate Scavs at the new gas station on Customs
Hand over the found in raid item: Metal fuel tank

tasks.desc:
Hello, merc. I have a new task, though I cannot tell yet if you are fit for a real job.

But you seem eager to help, so I might give you a chance to prove yourself.

The more experienced warriors who are already working for the good of Tarkov need to replenish their fuel reserves.

So you have a chance to do a good deed and prove to me that some drunken thug won't be a problem for you. 

Bring me two cans of fuel. But don't run from the fight. To clean the city of filth, you must be ready to face the enemy head-on.
tasks.okMsg:
Look who's back. You meet any of those pillagers? Well-well... Maybe you're actually fit for it.

Get some rest for now, but do stay in touch. You've got some serious work ahead of you.

tasks.name: Belka and Strelka

obj.text: Survive and extract from Customs through Railroad Passage (Flare)

tasks.desc:
Hey, soldier! I've got a new reconnaissance mission for ya.

I was able to arrange a deal with the fellas who control the railroad at the old customs gas station, but I haven't sent any of my couriers that way yet. We gotta check it out first.

The plan is simple: you fire the green flare and extract. It's like a job Belka did... or was it Strelka? Ah, whatever, you know what I'm trying to say.

I'll pay you for risking your skin, but make sure you don't get whacked before even getting to that place, and take your time on the exit itself. I've heard enough tales of mercs who shoot the flare and run to the exit immediately before the flare even lights up properly... On a completely unrelated note, may I interest you in a cheap new helmet with bullet hole vents?
tasks.okMsg: There, I told you it was a simple job! You can trust me, I'd never send an untrained soldier into harm's way.

tasks.name: Private Club

obj.text: Locate and obtain Skier's wallet on Customs
Hand over the found item

tasks.desc:
Opachki, would you look at this little character. You got any ibuprofen? My noggin's fucking killing me.

What, something wrong, princess? Yes, I got hammered last night, so what? It was a major league game! They wouldn't let a twat like you anywhere near that table.

Sometimes we get together to test our luck, but yesterday clearly wasn't my day. Not only did I lose a shitload of money, but also my fucking wallet.

You're here for work, ye? Here, I'll give you a fucking job. Find my wallet. And don't even try any bullshit, I'd recognize mine with my eyes closed. You may still be young and don't realize it, but there are things in life worth more than cash.
tasks.okMsg:
Proper good fucking job mate! I knew it couldn't just vanish into thin air like that. We have some kind of connection, you and I.

This little baby is like a lucky charm for me. When I bought this wallet, things went booming for me. I've gotten it lost a thousand times since then, but it always comes back to me.

tasks.name: Connections Up North

obj.text: Eliminate PMC operatives with a bolt-action rifle with night or thermal scope

tasks.desc:
Greetings, mate. Tell you what, I've got special import channels - they can bring things even from Finland! My friend there has set up a shipment of some real deadly toys, not just shitty-ass Toz or Gornostay. Thing is, you can't just sell those to any random bum off the street, speaking from experience, mate. Dumb twats with hands out their asses will bring down the credibility of even the toughest merchandise. 

That's why I've come up with a little innocent trick. I want to start a rumor that there's a real bringer of death in Tarkov, you feel me? He shoots precisely and leaves heaps of corpses on his path. No one can even spot him in time, because the guy's a specialist, he sticks to the shadows and uses a bolty with a night sight. 

And then it turns out that this guy is using my guns! It's gonna make everybody think that I'm the guy who stocks up on the realest pro stuff. So I figured you'd be the perfect man for this little stunt. Make people afraid to even take a piss at night, and I'll arrange some of my hot new products for you. The first batch is free!
tasks.okMsg: I shit you not, even my partners heard about it! You're gonna become a real legend with this Finnish lady by your side.

tasks.name: Shady Contractor

obj.text: Locate the Knossos LLC senior manager's car on Ground Zero
Locate and obtain the manager's diary
Hand over the diary

tasks.desc:
Hey. You may be aware that TerraGroup's aggressive expansion in Tarkov has raised quite a few questions in its time, no doubt? Back then, they were buying out properties and companies left and right in the Norvinsk region, and some of the deals were clearly shady in nature...

TerraGroup has had a particularly interesting contractor, a company called Knossos. Officially they build amusement parks, playgrounds, and other family entertainment venues. But tell me, what possible connection can TerraGroup's scientific research and playgrounds have?

That's exactly why this smells fishy to me. Knossos could be hiding TerraGroup documents or equipment. Yet to know for certain, we'd have to examine their facilities. And to do that, we'd have to find some kind of record... Knossos definitely had managers overseeing the facilities. You should check out the vehicles in the city center and look for any internal records there.
tasks.okMsg: A manager's diary, huh? Even though it's not official documentation, there might be something useful in there. I'll get back to you in a bit, right now I need to examine these records carefully.

tasks.name: Needle in a Haystack

obj.text: Investigate the courtyard park by TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero
Investigate the kart track on Interchange
Investigate the indoor children's playground on Interchange
Investigate the children's playground by Concordia on Streets of Tarkov
Investigate the coast-side construction site on Shoreline
Investigate the children's playground by the Health Resort on Shoreline

tasks.desc:
You're just in time! I have studied the manager's diary and prepared for you a list of facilities that appear most often in the records. You need to investigate all of these locations. 

So far, I can't tell what exactly to look for. Maybe you'll find equipment or other traces of TerraGroup around there. Focus on these locations and look around.
tasks.okMsg: Really, nothing at all? Perhaps it really is just a coincidence... I'll have to think about it and check my sources again.

tasks.name: Hidden Layer

obj.text: Locate a good lead related to Knossos LLC
Find a way inside the Knossos LLC facility
Locate and obtain the Knossos LLC facility key

tasks.desc:
You know, I've thought it over again and I'm definitely positive there's a hidden layer to TerraGroup's connection with Knossos. Granted, we don't know what they were hiding yet, but that just means we haven't searched hard enough. We need to double-check everything again.

Try to examine the Knossos facilities from the list again, you can also check out the adjacent buildings. Although last time my advice didn't lead you to a proper result... This time, you'd better trust your skills and intuition. Maybe we'll get lucky this way.
tasks.okMsg:
Why didn't I think of that before? Knossos didn't purchase the whole territory of Azure Coast, but only the basements under it! That's why I thought this playground was our target.

A door like this is unlikely to be accessed with a regular TerraGroup keycard. Considering they, meaning TerraGroup specifically, disguised that place as a Knossos facility, the keycard to access it should probably also have a suitable design.

I'll try to find out more about these keycards and secure access to them, but it will take a considerable amount of time. If you don't wanna wait, try to find some other useful information, or better yet, the keycards themselves.

tasks.name: The Tarkov Butcher

obj.text: Locate and obtain the chemical container on Ground Zero
Stash the container by the police station on Streets of Tarkov

tasks.desc:
Greetings. Yes, Sergei told me that you're looking for the keycards to the health resort basement. I have no idea what is down there, but one of my colleagues visits there somewhat often. Perhaps it is one of the places where he might store valuable equipment... It's hardly anything important if he agrees to give you the keycards. Obviously, it wouldn't be for free.

You may have heard stories about a certain, um, criminal operating out of the central city district? The first rumors of the Tarkov Butcher date back to the Contract Wars. However, some of my patients say that he still haunts the streets... 

A colleague of mine has taken an interest in this matter and is looking for traces of this “butcher”. For the greater good, naturally. Such a dangerous individual is not simple to track down, therefore we must understand his motives and goals, no matter how much they diverge from human values. 

We were able to obtain a criminal case file from the local police department. According to this, the “butcher” worked as a driver for a meat packing plant here in the city limits. The bodies of the victims were found in refrigerator trucks used to transport frozen meat... But as the conflict escalated, the case was abandoned.

Now, you have all the details. If you can find anything to help my colleague's research, he will hand you the keycards to that basement.
tasks.okMsg:
Did he seriously transport the bodies of his victims along with the meat, which then went to the store shelves? That is appalling. The fact that you found this substance used by the maniac will help my colleague make progress on the... evidence file on this case.

Here are your keycards, I already received them. Along with them, I was asked to tell you to watch your step when visiting the basement. Apparently the cellars have deteriorated over the years.

tasks.name: Sensory Analysis - Part 1

obj.text: Obtain the item: Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Go to Woods or Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to BTR driver

tasks.desc:
Hello my brother! Okay, okay, not so loud, I'm hung over as shit. Don't know how the BTR guy's still driving after last night. The engine is surely screeching louder than fucking generators!

By the way, you came at a really good time, almost like you knew I'm gonna need help. So, about the meeting we had yesterday. I have a moonshine supplier, he makes legit good stuff! We've been working together for six months now, everything was fine. And now, customers started complaining that I was selling them fake stuff. So, I had to check the product quality, and no one in our region knows as much about liquor as the BTR driver.

So I invited him over for... let's call it sampling, hehe. And there he was, saying that no one starts with hard hitters right off the bat, he needed a warm-up. Then another. Then another... So after all that, I checked the moonshine in the morning, and we didn't even open it!

Long story short, the driver didn't finish the job. I'm not gonna live through this kind of sampling party a second time, so I'll let him taste everything by himself. Can you pass him this bottle? Don't lose it, alright?
tasks.okMsg:
So, did'ya deliver the bottle? Huh? Man, this driver guy's such a prick. I love him! Hey, easy there, man, I get it. Listen, some things just shouldn't be talked about right off the bat, the Labyrinth is one of them.

I have to consider all the risks that come with this info, so sit tight for a little while.

tasks.name: Sensory Analysis - Part 2

obj.text: Find a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

tasks.desc:
I miscalculated my abilities yesterday at a friendly get-together. Don't worry, we've sailed in worse storms than this. One time I was so wasted I couldn't find the gearbox in this thing. So I tied my hand to the lever with a bandage! Inventiveness is the main principle for a machinist!

Ragman needed to check some goods, and I'm a veteran in this field. Except I can't remember, for the life of me, whether we finally got to his test sample or not. Well, whatever. If it's so important, we can get together again. Such an evening is a sin not to do again, I know you'd like it too!

But still, if you need to visit Ragman, ask him about the moonshine, I promised I'd help him. And now I don't even know if I did help him or not.
tasks.okMsg:
Are you sure this is it? Okay, I can smell it, that's definitely the one! 

Ragman told me about the health resort's cellars yesterday, I even had to fucking get him wasted so we could finally change the subject. Anyway, there was a Soviet bomb shelter under the health resort, and Ref was going to organize a new arena there, for VIP audiences. I think it also involved Tagilla somehow... No, it was something else...

Anyway, for this arena, Ref organized a big gear acquisition from Ragman, everything was almost ready. And then our host guy suddenly backed out. Why? Who the fuck knows.

Ragman was really upset that the idea had fallen through. But he'd already delivered some of the gear, and he definitely used those keycards you're looking for. You better ask him yourself, I don't remember much from yesterday. Thanks for the drink, by the way.

tasks.name: Compensation for Damage - Wergild

obj.text: Hand over RUB

tasks.desc: You know, doing errands all day is still not enough to improve your poor situation. I think there is an easier way. Bribe the right people and they'll sing praises about how amazing you are. For example, you can compensate the friends of those you killed due to your brain disorder. Something like a wergild for murder in the Middle Ages.
tasks.okMsg: Outstanding. Part of the compensation will go where it needs to go, and the other part will stay with me. Let's say it's for maintaining our cooperation.

5937fd0086f7742bf33fc198.desc: A bronze pocket watch on a chain with an eagle on the cover, from a private antique collection.

591092ef86f7747bb8703422.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0022 and a strange symbol on it.

5938188786f77474f723e87f.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0031 and a strange symbol on it.

591093bb86f7747caa7bb2ee.name: Sealed letter
591093bb86f7747caa7bb2ee.desc: A package with correspondence found on the Scav's body in the Factory.

590dde5786f77405e71908b2.name: Bank case
590dde5786f77405e71908b2.desc: An armored bank case. It clearly hides something valuable, and thus survived many attempts of breaking it open.

5910922b86f7747d96753483.name: Carbon case
5910922b86f7747d96753483.desc: An expensive-looking armored case, which has "Property of TerraGroup Labs Inc" written on it.

5938878586f7741b797c562f.name: Secure Folder 0052
5938878586f7741b797c562f.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0052 and a strange symbol on it.

593965cf86f774087a77e1b6.name: Secure Folder 0048
593965cf86f774087a77e1b6.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0048 and a strange symbol on it.

5939a00786f7742fe8132936.name: Golden Zibbo lighter
5939a00786f7742fe8132936.desc: A golden gasoline Zibbo lighter. Property of a certain Uruguay - a local bandit.

5939e5a786f77461f11c0098.name: Secure Folder 0013
5939e5a786f77461f11c0098.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0013 and a strange symbol on it.

590c62a386f77412b0130255.name: Sliderkey Secure Flash drive
590c62a386f77412b0130255.desc: The Sliderkey secure flash drive. Such USB sticks are frequently used by TerraGroup management. They can definitely contain sensitive data.

5939e9b286f77462a709572c.name: Sealed letter with a TG logo
5939e9b286f77462a709572c.desc: A package with correspondence with a "TG" logotype. If unsealed, the value of it is instantly gone.

5a0448bc86f774736f14efa8.name: Key to the closed premises of the Health Resort
5a0448bc86f774736f14efa8.desc: A key to the closed premises of the Azure Coast Health Resort.

5a294d8486f774068638cd93.name: UAV SAS disk #2
5a294d8486f774068638cd93.desc: A reinforced case with an SAS hard drive. Used for data storage in military industry.

5a294d7c86f7740651337cf9.name: UAV SAS disk #1
5a294d7c86f7740651337cf9.desc: A reinforced case with an SAS hard drive. Used for data storage in military industry.

5a29284f86f77463ef3db363.name: Toughbook reinforced laptop
5a29284f86f77463ef3db363.desc: A laptop in a special protected case. Used by military and private companies in the face of the increased danger of damage to the device.

5a29357286f77409c705e025.name: Sliderkey Flash drive
5a29357286f77409c705e025.desc: The Sliderkey secure flash drive. Such USB sticks are frequently used by TerraGroup employees. This ones seems to have been used by the Health Resort workers.

5a29276886f77435ed1b117c.name: Working hard drive
5a29276886f77435ed1b117c.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Serves as the main data drive in most computers.

5a6860d886f77411cd3a9e47.name: Secure Folder 0060
5a6860d886f77411cd3a9e47.desc: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0060 and a strange symbol on it.

5a687e7886f7740c4a5133fb.name: Blood sample
5a687e7886f7740c4a5133fb.desc: A blood sample found on the car door. It was hard getting even this much.

5ac620eb86f7743a8e6e0da0.name: Package of graphics cards
5ac620eb86f7743a8e6e0da0.desc: A package sealed with a large amount of tape. It's quite battered, but the contents appear to be intact.

5ae9a0dd86f7742e5f454a05.name: Goshan cargo manifests
5ae9a0dd86f7742e5f454a05.desc: Goshan cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.

5ae9a18586f7746e381e16a3.name: OLI cargo manifests
5ae9a18586f7746e381e16a3.desc: OLI cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.

5ae9a1b886f77404c8537c62.name: IDEA cargo manifests
5ae9a1b886f77404c8537c62.desc: IDEA cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.

5ae9a25386f7746dd946e6d9.name: OLI cargo route documents
5ae9a25386f7746dd946e6d9.desc: Documents describing the route of shipment of batteries for OLI store in Ultra mall.

5ae9a3f586f7740aab00e4e6.name: Clothes design handbook - Part 1
5ae9a3f586f7740aab00e4e6.desc: A book on clothing design and manufacturing technologies with various materials. Part 1

5ae9a4fc86f7746e381e1753.name: Clothes design handbook - Part 2
5ae9a4fc86f7746e381e1753.desc: A book on clothing design and manufacturing technologies with various materials. Part 2

5b43237186f7742f3a4ab252.name: Chemical container #1
5b43237186f7742f3a4ab252.desc: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.

5b4c81a086f77417d26be63f.name: Chemical container #2
5b4c81a086f77417d26be63f.desc: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.

5af04c0b86f774138708f78e.name: Motor Controller #1
5af04c0b86f774138708f78e.desc: A configurable motor controller block used on main battle tanks and weapon systems.

5af04e0a86f7743a532b79e2.name: Single-axis Fiber Optic Gyroscope #1
5af04e0a86f7743a532b79e2.desc: An extremely durable single-axis fiber optic gyroscope developed for military applications in harsh environments. Used for vehicle navigation and weapon systems.

5efdafc1e70b5e33f86de058.name: Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol
5efdafc1e70b5e33f86de058.desc: A well-worn surgical first aid kit for bullet wounds and other serious injuries and wounds, heavily stained with blood and marked with a strange blue symbol.

5efdaf6de6a30218ed211a48.name: Marked Ophthalmoscope
5efdaf6de6a30218ed211a48.desc: A medical device for diagnostic eye examination, marked with a strip of tape.

5eff135be0d3331e9d282b7b.name: Flash drive marked with blue tape
5eff135be0d3331e9d282b7b.desc: A flash drive marked with blue tape. Such flash drives are often used by TerraGroup staff.

609267a2bb3f46069c3e6c7d.name: T-90M Commander Control Panel
609267a2bb3f46069c3e6c7d.desc: A tank commander control panel for controlling tank artillery. Allows the control of T-90M main cannon.

60915994c49cf53e4772cc38.name: Military documents #1
60915994c49cf53e4772cc38.desc: A folder with military notes and paper maps. An extremely valuable thing for foreign counterparties.

60a3b6359c427533db36cf84.name: Military documents #2
60a3b6359c427533db36cf84.desc: A folder with military notes and paper maps. An extremely valuable thing for foreign counterparties.

60a3b65c27adf161da7b6e14.name: Military documents #3
60a3b65c27adf161da7b6e14.desc: A folder with military notes and paper maps. An extremely valuable thing for foreign counterparties.

608c22a003292f4ba43f8a1a.name: Medical record #1
608c22a003292f4ba43f8a1a.desc: A journal with medical notes. The writing is barely readable, but it is of great value to certain third parties.

60a3b5b05f84d429b732e934.name: Medical record #2
60a3b5b05f84d429b732e934.desc: A journal with medical notes. The writing is barely readable, but it is of great value to certain third parties.

60c080eb991ac167ad1c3ad4.name: MBT Integrated Navigation System
60c080eb991ac167ad1c3ad4.desc: The central control block of the GALS-D3 navigational complex for T-72 and T-90 tanks.

619252352be33f26043400a7.name: Laptop with information
619252352be33f26043400a7.desc: A laptop in a special protected case. Used by military and private companies in the face of increased danger of damage to the device.

619268de2be33f2604340159.name: Water pump operation data
619268de2be33f2604340159.desc: A document containing data about water pumps at the water treatment plant.

619268ad78f4fa33f173dbe5.name: Pumping station operation report
619268ad78f4fa33f173dbe5.desc: A document containing operational reports of the pumping station at the water treatment plant.

6399f54b0a36db13c823ad21.name: Radio transmitter body
6399f54b0a36db13c823ad21.desc: A body of the DSP transmitter.

6331bb0d1aa9f42b804997a6.name: Secure Flash drive V3
6331bb0d1aa9f42b804997a6.desc: A secure flash drive with unknown information. Write-protected and labeled "V3".

628393620d8524273e7eb028.name: Working hard drive
628393620d8524273e7eb028.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains information on aerial movement in the Norvinsk region.

63a943cead5cc12f22161ff7.name: Accountant's notes
63a943cead5cc12f22161ff7.desc: A diary with all sorts of financial data.

638cbb3ba63f1b49be6a300e.name: Secure Flash drive
638cbb3ba63f1b49be6a300e.desc: A flash drive found inside the car dealership manager's office.

638cbc68a63f1b49be6a3010.name: Registered letter
638cbc68a63f1b49be6a3010.desc: A letter from Prapor. Better not open it.

638df4cc7b560b03794a18d2.name: AG guitar pick
638df4cc7b560b03794a18d2.desc: A guitar pick with the letters "AG" engraved on it.

638e0057ab150a5f56238960.name: Housing office journal
638e0057ab150a5f56238960.desc: A journal with a leather cover. Covered with various names, addresses and phone numbers.

63927b29c115f907b14700b9.name: Chemical container with samples
63927b29c115f907b14700b9.desc: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.

638dfc803083a019d447768e.name: Working hard drive
638dfc803083a019d447768e.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains CCTV footage from the Concordia residential complex.

638e9d5536b3b72c944e2fc7.name: Flash drive with recordings
638e9d5536b3b72c944e2fc7.desc: A secure flash drive containing various recordings.

63989ced706b793c7d60cfef.name: Informant's journal
63989ced706b793c7d60cfef.desc: A journal found inside the informant's hideout.

6398a0861c712b1e1d4dadf1.name: Forged Lightkeeper intelligence
6398a0861c712b1e1d4dadf1.desc: A fake intelligence, forged by Lightkeeper.

6398a072e301557ae24cec92.name: Lightkeeper intelligence
6398a072e301557ae24cec92.desc: An original intelligence, containing dirt on Lightkeeper.

64f09c02b63b74469b6c149f.name: Paramedic's GPhone X
64f09c02b63b74469b6c149f.desc: A smartphone with valuable data belonging to the ambulance paramedic.

64f07f7726cfa02c506f8ac0.name: Journal
64f07f7726cfa02c506f8ac0.desc: A journal of someone who really loves everything Soviet.

64f69b4267e11a7c6206e010.name: Chef's diary
64f69b4267e11a7c6206e010.desc: A diary containing valuable data belonging to a chef from the Beluga restaurant.

64f5b4f71a5f313cb144c06c.name: Secret component
64f5b4f71a5f313cb144c06c.desc: A vial with a secret component used to make the most delicious food. May also make you agree to ridiculous deals and tell all your company secrets.

6582bd252b50c61c565828e2.name: Bottle of Le Jean wine
6582bd252b50c61c565828e2.desc: A bottle of rare French collector soft wine Le Jean.

6575a6ca8778e96ded05a802.name: TerraGroup scientist's hard drive
6575a6ca8778e96ded05a802.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains various compromising data on TerraGroup.

657acb2ac900be5902191ac9.name: Cadastral registry records
657acb2ac900be5902191ac9.desc: Cadastral registry records containing data on TerraGroup real estate in Tarkov.

666073159916667083033cb9.name: Battered diary
666073159916667083033cb9.desc: A small diary that had been abandoned by its owner a long time ago. The entries are barely legible due to the rough handwriting.

666879d498b97e3a8f09f1ae.name: LEDX Skin Transilluminator (US Version)
666879d498b97e3a8f09f1ae.desc: You can argue endlessly that different factories of the same company provide comparable quality, but at the critical moment everyone chooses the original.... Perhaps TerraGroup had special arrangements with the American factory to supply a newer model of LEDX.

667a8ef464eea5fdef0db135.name: Gaming magazine
667a8ef464eea5fdef0db135.desc: An issue of a gaming magazine that first wrote about one world-famous shooter game.

66760b3deb51b08bd40c2b08.name: Hard drive
66760b3deb51b08bd40c2b08.desc: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains stolen user data.

66687bc89111279d600b5062.name: Tarkov City souvenir key
66687bc89111279d600b5062.desc: In the old days, the symbol of power in large cities was a luxurious key the size of a hand. In Tarkov, this tradition was revived, but the key itself was made smaller. Some say that this is the reason why it was lost: someone attached the souvenir to a bunch of keys by mistake and took it away from the town day celebration.

66c0b39ca1f68fcc1d0c0cc3.name: Lab journal
66c0b39ca1f68fcc1d0c0cc3.desc: The records in this journal reveal side effects after interacting with TerraGroup's drugs... The factory workers likely were unaware of this "research".

66c0b90c8398582e4b0c2e27.name: Pilot logbook
66c0b90c8398582e4b0c2e27.desc: A RUAF pilot logbook. It's unclear how it ended up in the cockpit of the foreign AS350 helicopter. Either the USECs ran out of their own logbooks, or the BEARs ran out of helicopters.

669fac549b0ce3feae01a137.name: Chemical sample
669fac549b0ce3feae01a137.desc: There's no telling what was in the tank container. It looks nasty, and smells even worse. TerraGroup must have used these tanks to store precursors for their research.

66a0e523e749756c920d02d0.name: Chemical container
66a0e523e749756c920d02d0.desc: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.

66a0f0926fee20fa70036da6.name: Blood sample
66a0f0926fee20fa70036da6.desc: A blood sample taken from the body of one of the workers at Chemical Plant No. 16. The bodies are clearly not recent, but the blood has not even dried up. Even the texture is the same as fresh blood.

66b22630a6b4e5ec7c02cdb7.name: Case with precision tools
66b22630a6b4e5ec7c02cdb7.desc: A case containing various expensive precision tools.

67499a9669a58fceba104a41.name: Package for Prapor
67499a9669a58fceba104a41.desc: A package that the BTR driver was supposed to deliver to Prapor.

67499b9b909d2013670a5029.name: KOSA UAV electronic jamming device
67499b9b909d2013670a5029.desc: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.

67499adbeca8acb2d2061634.name: Cargo for Prapor
67499adbeca8acb2d2061634.desc: A delivery from outside the cordon that Prapor is waiting for. Judging by the weight, it feels like it's half-empty.

67499d4deca8acb2d206163b.name: KOSA UAV electronic jamming device
67499d4deca8acb2d206163b.desc: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.

67499d0eeca8acb2d2061639.name: Incriminating letter
67499d0eeca8acb2d2061639.desc: A letter from the BTR driver. Apparently, the information inside could put serious pressure on Skier.

67499b3eeca8acb2d2061636.name: Lightkeeper's case
67499b3eeca8acb2d2061636.desc: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.

67499d2c69a58fceba104a43.name: Lightkeeper's case
67499d2c69a58fceba104a43.desc: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.

675f7acc4076a741a3061566.name: TerraGroup shipment report
675f7acc4076a741a3061566.desc: A stack of documents with data on TerraGroup shipments. Contains reports on completed and planned shipments.

675f7b168d28a25ec7007dbb.name: Delivery crew report
675f7b168d28a25ec7007dbb.desc: It looks like this journal was used by the entire loading crew to mark all the loads that had already been completed. How could the foreman make any sense of this handwriting?

675f80d4fe1b59cf490d3527.name: Box with upgraded tools
675f80d4fe1b59cf490d3527.desc: The box is sealed, but judging by the sounds inside, it contains the tools Mechanic was looking for.

675f7f224076a741a3061568.name: Skier's wallet
675f7f224076a741a3061568.desc: It's hard to believe this wallet is anything special to Skier. It's just an old, shabby wallet. How has it not disintegrated yet?

679b9a1a4e4ed4b3b40ae5c2.name: Knossos senior manager's diary
679b9a1a4e4ed4b3b40ae5c2.desc: Meetings, facilities, and other notes from Knossos senior manager are noted in the diary. If you study them, you can get at least a rough summary of the company's facilities.

679b98e429acd1f2f60985a3.name: Container with suspicious substance
679b98e429acd1f2f60985a3.desc: A chemical container with a thick, murky liquid inside. Only a lunatic like Sanitar would want to study something like this.

679b9aa490622daf9708da73.name: VPX Flash Storage Module marked Group #3
679b9aa490622daf9708da73.desc: The VPX Flash Storage Module (FSM) provides high-performance, high-capacity, solid-state SATA storage with AES-256 bit encryption using an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC). Judging by the marking, it contains data on the focus group experiments and research.

679b998180a165f7a40b4c2c.name: Slaughter videotape
679b998180a165f7a40b4c2c.desc: A videotape with traces of blood and the words “Slaughter”. The owner of the tape hardly felt sympathy for his victims.

683ed6aed885538c4102d8c8.name: AK-50 barrel
683ed6aed885538c4102d8c8.desc: A 24 inch barrel for the AK-50 sniper rifle.

683ed6c2e4b1dd7ec4069dc8.name: AK-50 dust cover
683ed6c2e4b1dd7ec4069dc8.desc: A receiver dust cover for the AK-50 sniper rifle.

683ed6ccd9a096739b0c9228.name: AK-50 handguard with gas block
683ed6ccd9a096739b0c9228.desc: An M-LOK handguard with railed gas block for the AK-50 sniper rifle.

68666482abad2f29b00aab57.name: Programmer's phone
68666482abad2f29b00aab57.desc: A broken generic phone, nothing out of the ordinary. However it might help to find Mechanic's acquaintance.

6866663e022740fabd074ef2.name: Programmer's diary
6866663e022740fabd074ef2.desc:
An unremarkable diary, there are hundreds of those in Tarkov. But don't judge a book by its cover: this particular one contains many dangerous secrets.

The first page has a table of contents:
• Update
• Notes 
• Highlights
• Encrypt
• Agenda 
• Ruminates
• Drafts

687502c4660d147e2502a94f.name: Disk with release version
687502c4660d147e2502a94f.desc: A simple disk with a handwritten note that this is the second version, the final one. Finally you can go through the whole game all the way to the end. Gotta write a review later!

664fce7a90294949fe2d81cb.name: Ref dirt
664fce7a90294949fe2d81cb.desc: A folder of photos, charts, bank records, e-mail printouts and surveillance diaries of Arena employees.

6a898d53c891636d94044435.name: Box with supplies for Rogues
6a898d53c891636d94044435.desc: The box isn't particularly heavy, so it probably contains documents or fragile electronics.

6a898f9486c2a3db7e01ab25.name: Case with goods for the smugglers #1
6a898f9486c2a3db7e01ab25.desc: A case loaded with armor plates for the smugglers, which Ragman is planning to deliver to them. How much does this thing weigh?!

6a899014c891636d94044439.name: Case with goods for the smugglers #2
6a899014c891636d94044439.desc: A case loaded with armor plates for the smugglers, which Ragman is planning to deliver to them. How much does this thing weigh?!

69bb42b9ce2b96840302b92b.name: Nuclear power unit control log
69bb42b9ce2b96840302b92b.desc: The control log of a nuclear power unit records safety parameters, routine inspection results, and various measurements ensuring the safe operation of the Icebreaker’s nuclear reactor.

67bde1dc5678472f2a0e6167.name: G-Wagon flash drive
67bde1dc5678472f2a0e6167.desc: A flash drive found at the abandoned high-ranking TerraGroup staff's SUV. Contains something important, though it's unclear what exactly.

67bde22566ca1d79a202462f.name: Crashed plane's flight recorder
67bde22566ca1d79a202462f.desc: A flight recorder found at the plane that crashed in the Priozersk nature reserve. This device is crucial to figuring out what happened to the plane.

67bde548cf0cc29475092192.name: Elektronik's flash drive
67bde548cf0cc29475092192.desc: A flash drive Elektronik used to write the crashed plane crew's conversations. A very valuable piece of intel.

689b4d39987b304021088e8d.name: Plane crew transcript
689b4d39987b304021088e8d.desc: A printout of the transcript from the pilots of the downed aircraft.

67bde59edb4b617a6c0d69f8.name: Armored case
67bde59edb4b617a6c0d69f8.desc: A mysterious briefcase, apparently containing a certain "Ticket" out of Tarkov.

67bdea3ecf0cc29475092196.name: Experimental signal jammer
67bdea3ecf0cc29475092196.desc: A device developed by TerraGroup, capable of suppressing digital signals within a 100 meter radius.

67bdf097600629c8f20322e5.name: TerraGroup Labs master keycard
67bdf097600629c8f20322e5.desc: A pass card that used to grant access to all doors within the system. Used exclusively inside TerraGroup laboratories. No longer operational.

67c0324acc87f341720274b6.name: RFID keycard encryption device
67c0324acc87f341720274b6.desc: A device capable of encrypting RFID card data. Features an integrated microcontroller. Commonly used within TerraGroup facilities.

68ea992027da8dde060ebfef.name: Note in the pumping station
68ea992027da8dde060ebfef.desc: A note left in the pumping station containing instructions for the maintenance crew.

67c033719dacd7c19f0f9f46.name: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence
67c033719dacd7c19f0f9f46.desc: A small container holding all the documents and audio tapes containing compromising material on TerraGroup. Now they’re guaranteed to reach Mr. Kerman intact.

68f77d874ea3f761790e8c05.name: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence
68f77d874ea3f761790e8c05.desc: A small container holding all the documents and audio tapes containing compromising material on TerraGroup. Now they’re guaranteed to reach Mr. Kerman intact.

68ea998f01b9ce77ac07081c.name: Electrical panel layout
68ea998f01b9ce77ac07081c.desc: A printout of the port terminal plan marking the locations of the electrical panels.

68dbc04cd700686fbf0d77bd.name: Bogatyrs patch
68dbc04cd700686fbf0d77bd.desc: A patch of some special BEAR unit.

68da4fa81ddecb1cc0077aee.name: Moreman's dogtag
68da4fa81ddecb1cc0077aee.desc: A dogtag belonging to the Bogatyr squad member who has seen hundreds of battles.

68da4fe6f0e86677fe06bfe4.name: Strelets' amulet
68da4fe6f0e86677fe06bfe4.desc: Someone fashioned a talisman from a crumpled bullet, either as a keepsake or for luck.

68da51d8f0e86677fe06c9b7.name: Taran's postcard
68da51d8f0e86677fe06c9b7.desc: On the back of the postcard, someone wrote: "Love you, waiting for you".

68fd5aa1c85d51c0130623c9.name: Voevoda's audio recorder
68fd5aa1c85d51c0130623c9.desc: An old voice recorder that, apparently, was used by Voevoda himself.

68d271fc17de6a40270d5657.name: Moreman's phone
68d271fc17de6a40270d5657.desc: A personal phone belonging to one of the Bogatyr squad members. Some data may still remain on it.

68e7d35483bb1cc4ac02d8c7.name: Hard drive from Rzhevsky's car
68e7d35483bb1cc4ac02d8c7.desc: A hard drive taken from A.P.’s car. Important data may still remain on it.

67ee77389fcc485cf10615f3.name: Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.
67ee77389fcc485cf10615f3.desc: A Sliderkey secure flash drive. These drives are commonly used by TerraGroup management. This one appears to have been used by someone with the initials "A.P.".

68e7d1be6656898e78015bd9.name: Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.
68e7d1be6656898e78015bd9.desc: A decrypted flash drive containing data belonging to a certain "A.P.". Includes various technical files. The word "Unheard" appears intermittently in the code, but the code itself doesn’t function or run anything.

68e638cf85c63c556c0272db.name: Unknown device fragment
68e638cf85c63c556c0272db.desc: A fragment of a device that apparently activated over Tarkov.

68c721ef980898142c0b3c5a.name: Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)
